description: paper_configs_v2: Qwen3-0.6B spline vs linear feature-match (d_t=4096) at 1B tokens, single seed, following the gpt2-small 1b_v3 recipe (grid refine DISABLED, deduped train-disjoint val). Sized for one 2-node x 2-GPU FSDP job: per-rank batch 32 = global 128 sequences/step, so 1B tokens x 0.95 / (128 x 128 tokens) = 58000 steps. Collection chunks reduced to 6M tokens because Qwen3-0.6B activations are ~115 KB/token (28 layers x 1024 dims x in+out x bf16), keeping each per-node /lscratch chunk near ~690 GB.
